# v1.3.2

## New features

- Added analytics: whenever you export a scan, the owned amounts (numbers only) are uploaded. I'm trying to see if I can make use of the data. Opt out anytime with the checkbox on the left of the scanner page.

## Fixes & improvements

- Minor ui improvements
- Added Belgardin bonus boxes
- Fixed irrelevant boxes with an ilevel requirement not losing "need hover" upon hover
- Fixed vambrace not being overwritten properly when fetching from lostark.bible
- Made "show all mats" show relevant T4 mats as well so that there is a way to overwrite T4 mats. (Pointed out by [#18](https://github.com/Kenivia/Honing-Forecast/issues/18), thanks for the report!)
